product.olivetti-philos-45-color.summary: The Philos 45 variant with an active-matrix colour display.
product.olivetti-philos-45-color.history: Olivetti marketed the colour version as Philos Color 45. The surviving unit’s label identifies model NB101S and manufacture in Italy.
product.olivetti-philos-45-color.archite: Headphones and a microphone could be connected. The side of the NB101S specimen shows both jacks and the volume control.
product.olivetti-philos-45-color.verifie: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-philos-45-color.limitat: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
